title: Ether treasury firm BTCS warns SEC its $54 million Aave loan could be liquidated
content: BTCS cut its reported Aave debt by about $10 million in ten days, but falling ether prices are keeping its collateral under pressure.

title: Bitcoin nodes could be stalled by repeating one ID 50,000 times. AI found the bug
content: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes on Friday for a bug flagged by Loupe, an open-source scanner from Block’s Spiral that uses AI agents to examine bitcoin code.

title: XRP falls 10% as long bets unwind and ETF assets slip below $1 billion
content: The token broke its previous November lows during Saturday's crypto selloff, with long positions accounting for most XRP liquidations and technical indicators showing further weakness.

title: Bitcoin tanks below $57,000 for the first time in two years, and its not alone
content: BTC's sell-off deepened on Saturday, with prices hitting two-year lows under $57,000.

title: Kalshi races to get ahead of New York order that could shut down exchange
content: The U.S. prediction market firm asked a New York court to give the company a chance to argue against a pending restraining order stemming from a new court loss.

title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits, securities experiments
content: Industry groups have until Dec. 11 to apply for the ECB’s first experimental exercises under its Appia initiative, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis.

title: US lawmakers propose up to 30% rewards for prediction market whistleblowers
content: Whistleblowers could receive 10% to 30% of monetary sanctions in qualifying prediction market fraud cases exceeding $1 million in penalties.

title: Hong Kong pushes to bring crypto custodians, advisers under licensing rules
content: Hong Kong’s securities regulator says the proposal would strengthen investor protections, with the bill set for its first reading in the Legislative Council on Dec. 2.

title: Wrapped Monero token crashes 99.8% amid suspected $13.5M exploit
content: Bitquery traced $13.5 million in suspicious sales of the wrapped Monero token, as its operator blamed a security breach and promised to reimburse affected traders.

title: Signal Calls OS-Level AI an 'Existential Threat' and Blocks Screenshots to Fight It
content: The encrypted-messaging app will restrict screenshots on iOS 27 and auto-enable screen security on Android when it detects an AI assistant reading a chat.

title: Is the AI Bubble Finally Popping? Nvidia Crashes 48% as Wall Street Experts Sound the Alarm
content: Tech stocks are buckling after Anthropic’s historic IPO and Nvidia’s leadership crisis, while Bitcoin has slipped below $60,000. Experts disagree on whether AI faces a correction or a dot-com-style bust.

title: Claude Claims Historic Math Breakthrough One Day After Anthropic IPO
content: Levent Alpöge claims Claude helped prove a 167-year-old math conjecture, but independent checks remain pending, and the release just after Anthropic’s IPO has prompted questions about its unusual publication timing.

title: Nvidia Shares Sink to 52-Week Low After Report SEC Is Probing Accounting
content: Nvidia shares fell about 13% to a 52-week low after reports that SEC enforcement staff are examining potential accounting issues, adding to pressure on the chipmaker after Jensen Huang’s resignation.

title: SBF’s 'The Altruists' Plot Twist: FTX’s Anthropic Shares Would Be Worth $43 Billion
content: Anthropic’s IPO made FTX’s liquidated AI bet a $43 billion what-if, just as Netflix premiered its Sam Bankman-Fried drama.

title: Tracy Schuchart: Bitcoin Trading “Like a Risk Asset” as Fed Hikes Loom
content: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Tracy Schuchart: Bitcoin Trading “Like a Risk Asset” as Fed Hikes Loom Tracy Shuchart says Bitcoin's biggest long-term argument is its monetary scarcity, but investors need to separate the long-term thesis from how it's trading today. title: Bitcoin Price Slips to Lows Not Seen Since 2024, Nasdaq Plunges 5%
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Slips to Lows Not Seen Since 2024, Nasdaq Plunges 5% The bitcoin price slipped to near $58,300 on Friday afternoon, briefly dipping under its summer low, as a chip-led selloff sent the Nasdaq down about 5% and dragged crypto stocks and miners sharply lower. This post Bitcoin Price Slips to Lows Not Seen Since 2024, Nasdaq Plunges 5% first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: MSTR Head of Investor Relations Addresses Bitcoin Pullback, Equity Performance
content: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine MSTR Head of Investor Relations Addresses Bitcoin Pullback, Equity Performance Chaitanya "CJ" Jain, Head of Investor Relations at Strategy, joins Bitcoin Magazine TV as Bitcoin trades below Strategy's average cost. This post MSTR Head of Investor Relations Addresses Bitcoin Pullback, Equity Performance first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .

title: SEC Freezes Assets in $560 Million Crypto Trading Ponzi Scheme
content: Bitcoin Magazine SEC Freezes Assets in $560 Million Crypto Trading Ponzi Scheme The SEC obtained an asset freeze against Backward Hat Capital and its founders, alleging a $560 million Ponzi scheme sold as AI-driven FX trading funded through crypto. Prosecutors and the CFTC filed parallel cases. This post SEC Freezes Assets in $560 Million Crypto Trading Ponzi Scheme first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal
content: Bitcoin Magazine Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal Blockstream researchers published a 131-page security analysis of SHRINCS, a hash-based post-quantum signature scheme for Bitcoin, and are asking the community to review it for flaws. This post Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
